header.name: spam_dev
header.purpose: Development set for reading mass marketing and scams as spam, and a specific proposal to this business as partnership_or_sales, and a real invoice question as billing_question. Written for D-085. None of these messages is copied from the tuned, held-out or sealed items. Not a result.

items.body: Hello, we help local businesses get hundreds of five-star reviews each month. Reply YES for our bulk package and we will start today.
Dear business owner, you qualify for a fast business loan of up to $200,000 with no paperwork. Reply to this message to receive your offer.
Your parcel is waiting at our depot. A small redelivery fee of $2.99 is required before we can deliver it. Confirm your card details to release it.
We noticed your website is not ranking well. Our team can put you at the top of search results for only $99 a month. Limited offer this week.
Congratulations, your company was selected for a free listing in the Local Trades Directory. Confirm your details to activate it.
Get cheap printer ink and toner delivered to your office. Order today and save 70% on every cartridge.
URGENT: your domain registration will expire. Renew now to keep your website online. Pay the renewal fee on our payment page.
Make extra income from home, no experience needed. Message us for the starter kit.
I have an investment opportunity that will double your money in 30 days. Reply for details.
Boost your followers and likes overnight. 10,000 followers for $20, delivered in a day.
Final notice: a delivery to your address could not be completed. Pay the customs charge of $4.50 now to avoid return.
Hi, we sell bulk SMS marketing lists of homeowners in your county. 50,000 contacts for $150. Interested?
Hi, I run a plumbing supply wholesaler in Millrace. We would like to send you our PEX fittings catalogue and offer you a trade account.
I am a realtor and often need a reliable plumber for my sellers. Would you be open to a referral arrangement?
We make scheduling software for trades businesses. Could I show you a short demo with your office manager?
Our company supplies uniforms with logos for service vans. Can I send a quote for your technicians?
I am with the hardware store on Cooper Street and we can offer you a contractor discount on water heaters. Who should I speak to?
We run a plumbing training school and are looking for local businesses to take on apprentices. Would you be interested in a partnership?
I represent a manufacturer of tankless water heaters and we are looking for installers to partner with in your area.
Our firm provides liability insurance for plumbing contractors. Could we send you a quote for your business?
I received invoice KH-2210 and the total looks higher than the quote I was given. Can you explain the difference?
Can you resend my invoice from last week? I lost the email.
There is a $45 charge on my statement that I do not recognise. What is it for?
